nodes.title: What The Car Needs
nodes.detail: 12 cases

nodes.title: Wants a warranty or recall visit, not a service
nodes.detail: Checks the car record and that the recall isn’t done. Safety recalls go to the centre now. Books running recalls; otherwise sends an enquiry to the service centre. Gives warranty dates with a note that the centre confirms.
nodes.notes: Open (Aftersales workshop): Should the AI agent book every running recall, or does the brand confirm each car first? What wording should the warranty date disclaimer use?
